name: OpenConditions
description: Live road conditions (incidents, roadworks, closures and traffic flow), fuel stations with their prices, parking sites with their free spaces and tariffs, EV charging sites with their charge points, status and tariffs, traffic and weather cameras with their current images, message signs with what they show, road weather stations with their measurements, road maintenance vehicles with their work, border crossings with their wait times, and weather alerts, earthquakes, natural events and fire detections from an OpenConditions instance

domain:road-conditions.purpose: Road incidents, roadworks, closures and traffic flow, read through OpenConditions
domain:road-conditions.dataSent: Nothing about the user: OpenMapX sends the OpenConditions server only map and route areas (bounding boxes), and OpenConditions reads road data by area from its own store, filled by polling its sources on its own schedule. A source it fetched on demand (none today) would receive the grid cells covering the area
domain:road-conditions.dataReceived: Situations with location, validity, severity and their effects on traffic

domain:fuel-stations.purpose: Fuel stations and their fuel prices, read through OpenConditions
domain:fuel-stations.dataSent: Nothing about the user. OpenConditions fetches some sources on demand: such a source receives the grid cells, or their centre points, covering the searched map area (or a box of about 200 m around a station when one is opened), and a keyed source also receives the operator's API key. Sources OpenConditions polls in bulk receive nothing
domain:fuel-stations.dataReceived: Stations with address, brand, opening hours, the fuels they sell and their prices

domain:parking-sites.purpose: Car parks and other parking sites with their free spaces and tariffs, read through OpenConditions
domain:parking-sites.dataSent: Nothing about the user. OpenConditions fetches some sources on demand: such a source receives the grid cells covering the searched map area (or a box of about 200 m around a site when one is opened). Sources OpenConditions polls in bulk receive nothing
domain:parking-sites.dataReceived: Parking sites with address, operator, opening hours, capacity, free spaces, spaces for particular vehicles and user groups, and tariffs

domain:charging-sites.purpose: EV charging sites with their charge points, connectors, live status and tariffs, read through OpenConditions
domain:charging-sites.dataSent: Nothing about the user. OpenConditions fetches some sources on demand: such a source receives the grid cells covering the searched map area (or a box of about 200 m around a site when one is opened), and a keyed source also receives the operator's API key. Sources OpenConditions polls in bulk receive nothing
domain:charging-sites.dataReceived: Charging sites with address, operator, opening hours, charge points, connector types and power, the live status of charge points, and tariffs

domain:cameras.purpose: Traffic, weather and scenic cameras with their views and current images, read through OpenConditions
domain:cameras.dataSent: Nothing about the user through OpenConditions: a source it fetches on demand receives the grid cells covering the searched map area (or a box of about 200 m around a camera when one is opened), and a keyed source also receives the operator's API key; sources it polls in bulk receive nothing. Camera stills are fetched by the OpenMapX server and shown through its image proxy. Video streams and third-party players load in the browser directly, only after the user clicks "Load media", so their provider receives the user's IP address and browser details
domain:cameras.dataReceived: Cameras with location, type, operator, their views with direction, status and refresh interval, the current image or stream of each view, and a link to the publisher's page

domain:message-signs.purpose: Dynamic message signs along the roads and the messages they show, read through OpenConditions
domain:message-signs.dataSent: Nothing about the user: OpenMapX sends the OpenConditions server only the searched map area (or a box of about 200 m around a sign when one is opened), and OpenConditions reads the signs from its own store, filled by polling its sources on its own schedule
domain:message-signs.dataReceived: Signs with location, road, facing direction, operator, working status and the lines of each page they show

domain:road-weather.purpose: Road weather stations and what they measure, read through OpenConditions
domain:road-weather.dataSent: Nothing about the user: OpenMapX sends the OpenConditions server only the searched map area (or a box of about 200 m around a station when one is opened), and OpenConditions reads the stations from its own store, filled by polling its sources on its own schedule
domain:road-weather.dataReceived: Stations with location, road and municipality, the air temperature, humidity, dew point, wind, visibility and precipitation they measure, and the state, temperature, friction, water, snow, ice and salt on the road surface at each sensor

domain:service-vehicles.purpose: Where road maintenance vehicles such as snowploughs and spreaders are and what they are doing, read through OpenConditions
domain:service-vehicles.dataSent: Nothing about the user: OpenMapX sends the OpenConditions server only the searched map area (or a box of about 200 m around a vehicle when one is opened), and OpenConditions reads the positions from its own store, filled by polling its sources on its own schedule
domain:service-vehicles.dataReceived: Anonymous vehicle positions with time, heading, the tasks reported and whether the plough is down or the spreader on; no vehicle or driver is named

domain:border-crossings.purpose: Land border crossings and how long their queues are, read through OpenConditions
domain:border-crossings.dataSent: Nothing about the user: OpenMapX sends the OpenConditions server only the searched map area (or a box of about 200 m around a crossing when one is opened), and OpenConditions reads the crossings from its own store, filled by polling its sources on its own schedule
domain:border-crossings.dataReceived: Crossings with location, the countries they join, opening hours and status, and for each queue its direction, the wait time and the lanes open

domain:hazards.purpose: Weather and civil-protection alerts, earthquakes, natural events and satellite fire detections, read through OpenConditions
domain:hazards.dataSent: Nothing about the user: OpenMapX sends the OpenConditions server only map and route areas (bounding boxes) and time windows, and OpenConditions reads hazard data from its own store, filled by polling its sources on its own schedule
domain:hazards.dataReceived: Alerts with area, severity, validity and the publisher's text, earthquakes and other natural events with place and time, and satellite fire detections with place, time and radiative power
